के संबंध में यदि दकसी व् य जि को कोई आपजि हो /सुझाि िेना हो तो, िे इस सूचना के प्र कािन की जतजि से तीस (30) दिनों की अिजध के भीतर ऑनलाइन पोर्वल citzservices.dda.org.in या ई-मेल भारत का रािपत्र : असाधारण 3 DELHI DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (MASTER PLAN SECTION) PUBLIC NOTICE New Delhi, the 7th March, 2025 F.20(19)2013/MP.—The following modification which the Delhi Development Authority / Central Government proposes to make to the Master Plan for Delhi -2021 / Zonal Development Plan of Zone ‘D’ (for Sl. No.1), Zone-A (for Sl. No. 2) and Zone-C (for Sl. No. 3) under Section 11-A of DD Act, 1957, is hereby published for public information. Any person having any objection/suggestion with respect to the proposed modification may send the objection/suggestion via online portal citzservices.dda.org.in or via e-mail to mpd2021.public@dda.org.in or in writing to the Commissioner-cum-Secretary, DDA, ‘B’ Block, Vikas Sadan, New Delhi-110023 within a period of thirty (30) days from the date of publication of this notice. The person making the objection or suggestion should also give his / her Name, Address and Telephone / Contact Number(s) / E-mail ID which should be readable. Proposed Modification: Sl. No. Location Area Land use as per MPD-2021/ZDP Land use changed to Boundaries 1. Proposed Residential (Group Housing) on Minto Road, New Delhi, falling in Planning Zone-D 1.41 Ha. (14,123 sqm.) “Recreational” P2 (City Park, District Park, Community Park) as per MPD- 2021. “Residential” North: Lane (ROW: 12m.) South: Jahangir Road (ROW as per ZDP-2001: 30.48 m.) East: Minto Road (ROW as per ZDP-2001: 30.48 m.) West: Bhavbhuti Marg (ROW as per ZDP-2001: 30.48 m) “Recreational” (District Park) as per ZDP of Zone- D- 2001 2. Site located near Lothian Cemetery, Yamuna Bazar falls in Planning Zone -A 1.2 Ha. “Residential” as per Zonal Development Plan of Zone-A “Recreational (District Park)” North: Mahatma Gandhi Marg South: Netaji Subhash Marg East: Hanuman Mandir West: Kela Ghat Marg 3. Site at Baraf Khana Chowk in Planning Zone-C 0.6 Ha. “Residential” as per Zonal Development Plan of Zone - C “Recreational (District Park)” North: Lala Hardev Sahai Marg South: Lala Hardev Sahai Marg East: Rani Jhansi Flyover West: Lala Hardev Sahai Marg/ Barfkhana Chowk The Text / Plan indicating the proposed modifications shall be available for inspection at the office of Deputy Director, Master Plan Section, DDA, 6th Floor, Vikas Minar, I.P. Estate, New Delhi-110002, on all working days within the period referred above. The text/plan indicating the proposed modifications is also available on the following link i.e. https://dda.gov.in/mpd-2021-public-notices-2025 and https://citzservices.dda.org.in SURENDRA KUMAR MEENA, Commissioner-cum-Secy.
